name: kubernetes-mcp
description: A read-only Kubernetes cluster inspection tool using Model Context Protocol.

tools.name: get_cluster_status
tools.description: Get overall cluster status including nodes and namespaces.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List all nodes with their status, capacity, and allocatable resources.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List all namespaces with their status and age.

tools.name: list_pods
tools.description: List pods, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_statefulsets
tools.description: List stateful sets, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_daemonsets
tools.description: List daemon sets, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_cronjobs
tools.description: List cron jobs, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List recent events, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_ingresses
tools.description: List ingress resources, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: get_pod_logs
tools.description: Get logs from a specific pod. Optionally specify namespace and number of lines to tail.

tools.name: get_node_metrics
tools.description: Get CPU and memory usage for all nodes in the cluster (kubectl top nodes).

tools.name: get_pod_metrics
tools.description: Get CPU and memory usage for pods, optionally filtered by namespace (kubectl top pods).

tools.name: list_persistent_volumes
tools.description: List all persistent volumes with their status, capacity, and storage class.

tools.name: list_persistent_volume_claims
tools.description: List persistent volume claims with their status, requested size, and used storage. Optionally filter by namespace.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.description: List certificates from cert-manager with their status, expiration date, and issuer information. Optionally filter by namespace.

tools.name: list_pod_disruption_budgets
tools.description: List pod disruption budgets, optionally filtered by namespace.

tools.name: list_network_attachment_definitions
tools.description: List network attachment definitions from the CNI, optionally filtered by namespace.
